curriculum.name_vi: Chương trình cử nhân ngành Công nghệ thông tin, chuyên ngành Kỹ thuật phần mềm

plos.name: PLO1
plos.description: Understand basic knowledge of social sciences, political law, national security and defense, contributing to the formation of a scientific worldview and methodology.

plos.name: PLO2
plos.description: Apply solid scientific foundation knowledge in the field of information technology in general and software engineering in particular to understand the professional context and acquire in-depth specialized knowledge of software engineering.

plos.name: PLO3
plos.description: Apply in-depth specialized knowledge, new technologies in the field of software engineering, or expanded knowledge (in fields close to software engineering) to work and propose solutions to meet diverse needs from reality.

plos.name: PLO4
plos.description: Have basic knowledge of planning and operating, implementing, and supervising the implementation of plans for specialized work in the field of software engineering.

plos.name: PLO5
plos.description: Have a mindset about startups and apply startup knowledge and skills to implement a startup project; have creative thinking, research skills, critical thinking and problem solving.

plos.name: PLO6
plos.description: Have intermediate English proficiency equivalent to level 4 according to the 6-level foreign language competency framework for Vietnam, and be able to communicate simply in Japanese.

plos.name: PLO7
plos.description: Have the ability to communicate and present to clearly state the problem to be solved and convey knowledge and skills when performing specific/complex professional tasks related to software engineering.

plos.name: PLO8
plos.description: Have the ability to program and use analysis, design, construction/implementation, and testing tools in the field of software engineering.

plos.name: PLO9
plos.description: Have the ability to update and exploit advanced tools and techniques in the field of software engineering in particular and information technology in general.

plos.name: PLO10
plos.description: Develop the ability to work independently as well as work effectively in a team in an academic and practical environment; take personal responsibility and responsibility for the team when performing a professional job. Have the spirit of self-study, lifelong learning, adapt to the continuous changes of technology and society.

plos.name: PLO11
plos.description: Behave professionally, ethically, socially responsible and have a spirit of serving the community; have professional responsibility and integrity in work.

plos.name: PLO12
plos.description: Be mentally and physically strong, demonstrate national identity, and be confident in international integration.

plos.name: PLO13
plos.description: Be able to plan, coordinate, and manage resources related to software engineering projects; guide and supervise the implementation of project tasks and at the same time, be able to evaluate the effectiveness of the project and propose feasible and effective solutions for improvement.

courses.name: Ho Chi Minh Ideology
courses.name_full: Ho Chi Minh Ideology_Tư tưởng Hồ Chí Minh

syllabus_details.tools: Internet, pdf reader and AI-based learning tools (for responsible use, recommended as supplementary support)
syllabus_details.student_tasks: Nhiệm vụ của sinh viên:- Tham gia tối thiểu 80% thời lượng môn học và tham dự đủ các buổi lên lớp, thảo luận theo quy định.- Phải có Giáo trình Tư tưởng Hồ Chí Minh (dành cho bậc đại học hệ không chuyên lý luận chính trị) do Bộ Giáo dục và Đào tạo ban hành.- Phải nghiên cứu giáo trình trước, chuẩn bị các ý kiến để đề xuất khi nghe giảng. Chuẩn bị thảo luận và đọc, sưu tầm các tư liệu có liên quan đến nội dung môn học.- Thực hiện đầy đủ các yêu cầu của giảng viên khi học trên lớp cũng như các chủ đề sinh viên tự chuẩn bị trước khi đến lớp.- Chỉ sử dụng máy tính xách tay trong lớp cho mục đích học tập.- Ứng dụng AI một cách có trách nhiệm, đạo đức trong quá trình học tập và thực tiễn.Student's Tasks:- Attend at least 80% of class hours and participate in discussions as required.- Own the Ho Chi Minh's thought (Sửa lại từ sai lệch chính trị "Ho Chi Minh Ideology") textbook (for non-majors in political theory - Nâng cấp học thuật từ cụm "non-politics majored students") issued by the Ministry of Education and Training.- Study the textbook in advance, prepare ideas to propose during lectures. Prepare for discussions and read, collect materials related to the course content.- Fulfill tasks given by the instructor in class as well as topics required to be prepared (Sửa lại ngữ pháp cho chuẩn mực từ cụm "needed to prepare") in advance.- Use laptops in class only for learning purposes.- Apply AI responsibly and ethically in both learning and practice.
